title: Ashfall: First Steps
summary: Set up clean water, shelter, and the first safe return route before widening the search.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Do not chase a distant signal on an empty stomach with dirty water in your pack. Secure a shelter marker, light, food, a water plan, and one return path you can recognize under pressure.

blocks.title: Water Before Salvage
blocks.body: Dirty water buys time, filtered water buys range, and clean water buys mistakes. Keep the route short until your water source is repeatable.
blocks.label: Clean Water Bottle
blocks.subtitle: Opening survival priority

blocks.title: Shelter Marker
blocks.body: Pick a visible base point and return there after each small win. A marked shelter turns scattered finds into progress because tools, filters, and scrap stop being stranded in random chests.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: The first good Ashfall day is modest: drinkable water, a lit shelter, a dump chest, basic food, and enough notes to repeat one route without panic.
